lines.92: 「Uu... Ellie, I'm sorry. I'm sorry... I'm so sorry... Please... don't be mean to me anymore...」
lines.93: 「Let this teach you not to come up with stupid plans again, okay? You understand how scary payback can be now, right?」
lines.96: 「Relax. I'm not abandoning you. You're human, after all.」
lines.97: After being strict with her, the Princess finally pulled Yoshimi into a gentle hug.
lines.98: It almost looked like training a dog that had bitten the hand feeding it.
lines.99: 「She's got some troublesome sides, as you just saw, but she's still adorable, right?」
lines.101: 「Then protect her properly. Her heart too. If anything about Yoppi ever troubles you, you can always come talk to me.」
